audience.setting: 一般日常护肤科普，非个体诊疗

science.languages: 不按语言排除；中文、英语起查，相关其他语言原始来源按需核验
source_categories: 机制研究（须标明外推限制）

interest.metrics: 仅记录可见真实指标及采集时间，缺失为null；不推断实际受众地域

access.knowledge_base: 仅正式接口或版本化导出；禁止底层数据库

stop.budget_exhausted: 立即停止新增访问并登记缺口，不等于研究合格
stop.saturation: 提前饱和仅当相关分支覆盖合格、候选阻塞证据已满足或已核实在允许来源不可得，且连续两次有效查询无新增合格来源/主张/实质冲突。仅登记尚可补查的关键缺口不能触发饱和；有依据的缺口进入剩余额度内的S2。
stop.candidate_gate: 有关键科学/兴趣缺口则不可标正式合格候选
stop.unresolved_target: 目标或预算耗尽、允许路线不可得则停止并保留未合格；不为凑齐完成而扩大预算。

runs.topic: 熬夜肌攻略：睡眠不足与皮肤外观、屏障及日常护理边界
runs.objective: 区分观察关联、因果证据与短期外观感知，给出可表达且不夸大的改善优先级
core_questions: 睡眠不足与哪些皮肤变化有关，哪些因果尚未成立
短期外观变化与屏障/长期老化证据如何区分
改善睡眠和日常护肤各自能解决什么，哪些不能承诺
exclude: 用护肤抵消熬夜的保证

runs.topic: 皮肤干燥、紧绷与屏障受损：表象、可能原因和护理优先级
runs.objective: 验证结果型从表象到原因、边界、改善与见效层级的可复用研究流程
core_questions: 干燥紧绷是否等同屏障受损，什么情况下不能这样推断
环境、清洁、护理和疾病相关因素如何分层
基础保湿/减少刺激的证据与需要专业就诊的边界是什么
exclude: 把全部敏感症状归因于屏障

paper.scoring: Only score dimensions supported by reviewed methods and disclosures; missing facts remain unknown, not invented scores. Unknown overall assessment is unassessed, never strong by default.
paper.fatal_flaw_policy: Not eligible to support a key conclusion regardless of score; retain defect and reasons.

evidence.mechanism: Record cell/animal/human model; no direct extrapolation to clinical efficacy.
evidence.candidate_science: Strong is a reasoned claim-level assessment from eligible evidence, not a count of papers or one paper score.
evidence.candidate_interest: High/medium requires observed comparable evidence and stated rationale; low and unknown remain distinct. No invented absolute heat threshold.

required_scientific_categories: 机制研究（须标明外推限制）
publication_and_index_ecosystems: PubMed or another appropriate professional index for discovery
original journal/publisher including relevant Springer Nature and other publishers
coverage.ecosystem_rule: Source categories and retrieval entry points are separate. Search across relevant ecosystems within the same query budget; record uncovered relevant ecosystems and effects, do not require irrelevant publisher quota.
coverage.time_rule: For each science window record representative eligible sources or a reasoned gap; overlapping windows count the original material once.
coverage.complete_rule: Every relevant branch field has sourced content or an explicit applicable/not-applicable/unknown judgment. A registered key gap is not complete coverage; proxy acceptance cannot create evidence eligibility.
coverage.deduplication: Same DOI/PMID/original work or canonical platform content ID counts once; mirrors/translations/reposts share original identity. Across languages and categories do not recount. Cross-run reuse cites previous verification and records reuse separately from new reads.

s1_categories.mechanism: 机制研究（须标明外推限制）

accounting.query_rule: Each issued search belongs to exactly one category. Different language, market, keywords, index or personnel variants all consume that category limit; failed issued queries consume an attempt. Exact resubmission is not an effective variant and is not permitted as free retry.
accounting.read_rule: Scientific and platform observations share the 24 qualified-deep-read total per run. No separate/free platform or language pool. Original identity deduplicates across categories; failed/abstract-only/index-lead reads are recorded as attempts, not qualified full reads.
accounting.qualified_read: Original page or trustworthy original record actually accessed with publisher/author, time, applicability and exact locator. Claims cannot exceed retrieved content. Abstract-only is not full-method verification.
accounting.s2_rule: At most 2 stable typed targets with an explicit blocking gap, each at most 3 issued query variants and 6 newly qualified reads; no full S1 rescan and no transfer of unused category/target budget.
accounting.budget_exhaustion: Any applicable query/read/target limit blocks the next exceeding operation. Other unaffected categories may continue within their own limits. Access-blocked route stops immediately.

policy_binding.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON, ensure_ascii=false, sorted keys, separators comma/colon; omit only content_hash at root
policy_binding.startup: Before first theme query write a read-only audit snapshot from this exact config, include run_id, effective_at, revision, content_hash, and verify the hash. Research and all three stage freezes reference this bound policy.
policy_binding.mutability: Audit snapshots are immutable input evidence, never another editable parameter source. A future config change requires a new run revision and explicit migration; existing runs keep their original snapshot.

field_metadata.resolution: Each pointer in units_by_pointer resolves its value at the identical JSON pointer. Metadata = defaults + unit from this map + overrides_by_pointer[pointer]. Every config leaf outside field_metadata and content_hash is covered. No duplicate editable values.
